executive_assessment.text: Report estimates 1.5°C warming since the 1950s and rainfall decline from 85 mm (1950) to 63 mm (2020); June 2020-November 2022 drought affected up to one-third of people and worsened food insecurity.
World Bank modeling in the report estimates climate-related GDP losses of 9.3% by 2050 under its dry/pessimistic scenario without adaptation, compared with 5.7% with partial adaptation.
